card.name: Commas in combination painkiller names; alcohol-containing products
card.fires_on: Commas inside combination analgesic names such as butalbital, acetaminophen, caffeine, and the word contain/containing in 'products containing alcohol' warnings in opioid labels.

modes.label: Commas in combo drug names
modes.description: The comma after butalbital or acetaminophen in a list of combined ingredients with codeine or aspirin.
modes.example: Codeine in combination with butalbital<<,>> acetaminophen, and caffeine is

modes.label: Products containing alcohol
modes.description: The word contain or containing in the instruction to avoid products with alcohol while on an opioid.
modes.example: Patients must not consume alcoholic beverages or prescription or non-prescription products<< containing>> alcohol while on Oxymorphone Hydro

card.writes: It nudges the output toward words like derivative(s), stimulation and pain, with no strong link to the suppressed junk tokens.
card.plain: It fires at the comma inside combination painkiller names and at 'containing' in warnings about products with alcohol.
